body.label: Target
body.html: Self and one adjacent willing ally, or self alone.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Each target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn, provided it is still adjacent to you when damaged. You always qualify.

surges.html: The ally may move 1 unit toward you.
Each target also gains +1 Fortitude against the next melee attack targeting it until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Authority - Formation
rider.html: Spend this Authority when a protected creature is pushed before your next turn: another protected willing creature may follow it 1 unit; alone, you resist 1 unit of the push instead.
